subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant-thread status show sanitized per-tool progress, or should tool progress remain in loading messages, preview progress, native task cards, and opt-in status reactions?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing active tool labels through Slack native status is a UX and disclosure-policy choice that overlaps existing Slack progress surfaces and the open Slack-safe visibility work.

options.title: Decide Policy First
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers settle the Slack progress-disclosure/default policy before accepting another native per-tool status implementation.

options.title: Implement Sanitized Native Status
options.body: Allow a narrow Slack-owned implementation that reuses sanitized progress labels, dedupes repeated writes, clears reliably, and proves live Slack behavior.

options.title: Keep Native Status Generic
options.body: Narrow or close this request only if maintainers decide native Slack status should stay generic and detailed progress belongs only in existing progress surfaces.

recommendation.title: Decide Policy First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers settle the Slack progress-disclosure/default policy before accepting another native per-tool status implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work made Slack native status the preferred progress surface and preserved the current status wording, so this is the closest policy owner in the history.
